stop_rule.rule: PLAN.md 5.10: each in-form seed's ladder stops at its truth's form (an A truth at A, the A+B truth at A+B) and the chi^2 of that form's data-dominated parameters lies within its 99 %; within_noise (every in-sample statistic but E8 within R + z u_stat) and stopped_beyond_expected_form are diagnostics beside the verdict; the out-of-form seed fails a chi^2 that tests something; an empty chi^2 on any seed fails T0
stop_rule.on_sampling_failure: a T0 failure traced to sampling rather than a defect stops Run 1 for the engine: the seeds and the stream are never changed after a result; the team decides, recorded in defects.json, and any further seeds are T0_STREAM's next ones in order (5, 6, ...)
stop_rule.ladder_criterion: each engine's form is the first of A, A+B, A+B+C, A+B+C+D at which no in-sample statistic but E8 fails. A statistic fails a form only if |E_cal| - 2 u_stat > R, on its pooled value or on any of its deciding lines, u_stat the standard error the held-out rows compute (the standard error of the mean with one row or hold per cluster, the pooled u_stat for pooled rows, L0 at its maximising f, L1 from its two extreme lines); it passes if it does not fail and its pooled value or some deciding line has 2 u_stat <= R; otherwise (2 u_stat > R, or u_stat undefined) it neither blocks a form nor passes it, recorded per form, as a statistic with no calibration line that meets its population's line minimum neither blocks nor passes (contract section 2.4; JSON model_form.in_sample_rules: decisions 39(a), 49, 55; decision 77, 23 October 2026; L1 at its untightened R, decision 71)
